headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth, driven by AI and strong deal wins.
summary: Most listed firms reported double‑digit revenue growth YoY. TCS led with ₹73,188 cr and a 24% operating margin. HCLTech highlighted AI‑driven profit acceleration, while LTM and Tech Mahindra posted healthy top‑line gains. Profit margins varied, and several peers have yet to release results.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: AI revenue crossed 10% of TCS total and jumped 78% YoY at HCLTech, with LTM reporting a 47% surge.

themes.title: Robust deal wins
themes.detail: Large US‑dollar contracts were secured, notably $9.6 bn for TCS and $3.258 bn for HCLTech.

themes.title: Dividend payouts
themes.detail: Companies returned cash, with LTM announcing a ₹25 interim dividend and TCS paying ₹12 per share.

leaders.why: Highest revenue and strong operating margin; AI revenue now 10% of total.
15.6% YoY revenue growth and solid dividend payout.

laggards.why: Revenue grew but profit fell 25% and margins are low.
Results not yet released, limiting visibility.
